configuration.pagination: Fixed per endpoint; page0/size10, page0/size100 filtered, page9/size100 deep
configuration.scheduler: Dedicated benchmark runtime COMMERCE_JOBS_ENABLED=false; isolated demo runtime on8080 has scheduled checks but no browser writes during measurement.
configuration.databasePool: Actual protected Hikari snapshots before/during/after in operations endpoint.
configuration.schedule: closed loop; eight fixed GETs in order per worker; no retry

warmup.cacheState: uncontrolled; no flush or cold-cache claim

configuration.measurementWindow: Maven and frontend test/build completed; agents read-only; no Playwright running. Two Spring runtimes,Vite andIDE on same16logicalCPUlaptop.

dataset.note: Disposable SQL load fixture:1000orders3000lines1003variants333discountedorders3cartlines; not fulfillment E2E evidence.

statistics.percentileMethod: nearest rank; all attempted requests including failures
statistics.latencyScope: client wall time including HTTP connection/read/JSON; excludes think time
statistics.throughputScope: count / shared measured wall seconds; includes think/scheduling
statistics.setupExcluded: runtime checks, logins, dataset snapshots and warmup

operations.source: real staff-protected GET /api/admin/operations; sampled by workload, not continuous maxima

limitations: Bounded local dataset/workload; not production capacity evidence.
No business writes, provider calls, Redis test or SQL execution timing.
Session login is the only POST; separate cookie jars per worker and role.
